# De Dolle Brouwers

> Family-run craft brewery in Esen (Diksmuide), West Flanders, Belgium, brewing since 1980. Known for Oerbier, Arabier, Boskeun, Dulle Teve and Stille Nacht. Taproom (the Oerbar) open on weekends, brewery tour every Sunday, merchandise sold online. Official website: https://www.dedollebrouwers.be (the old site oerbier.be is no longer maintained).

Key facts:

- Address: Roeselarestraat 12B, 8600 Esen (Diksmuide), Belgium
- Email: info@dedollebrouwers.be
- Oerbar (taproom): Saturday and Sunday, 14:00–19:00
- Brewery tour: every Sunday, 14:00 in English and 15:00 in Dutch; about 45 minutes, includes three tastings from the cask; €10 per person; book and pay online, or buy a ticket on the spot while there is room. No tours during the Christmas closure (22 December – 18 January). Groups of 20 or more can ask for a separate tour by email.
- Beer is not sold in the webshop: buy it in the Oerbar or at the bars and shops on the "where to drink" map.
- Webshop (merchandise): hoodies, crewnecks, T-shirts, a cap, the Oerbier figure (also personalised), metal signs and glasses. Shipping to most of Europe, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Norway and Canada, and (until 15 January 2027, after which new US customs rules apply) the United States; import duties for the US are paid at checkout. Free pick-up in the Oerbar.

## Beers

- [Oerbier](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/oerbier): 9%, our first beer, dark, brewed with seven kinds of malt
- [Arabier](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/arabier): 8%, the blond counterpart of Oerbier, dry hopped
- [Boskeun](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/boskeun): 9%, one of the first Easter beers, with honey
- [Dulle Teve](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/dulle-teve): 10%, our tripel
- [Stille Nacht](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/stille-nacht): 12%, our prestige beer, for Christmas
- [Export Stout](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/export-stout): 8%, full-bodied with chocolate, coffee and liquorice
- [Lichtervelds Blond](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/lichtervelds-blond): 8%, golden blond
- [Oeral](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/oeral): 6%, a lighter Arabier, on draught only
- [Oerbier Reserva](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/oerbier-reserva): 9%, Oerbier aged at least a year in wine barrels, limited editions
- [Dulle Teve Reserva](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/dulle-teve-reserva): 10%, the tripel aged at least a year in wine barrels, limited editions
- [Stille Nacht Reserva](https://www.dedollebrouwers.be/en/beers/stille-nacht-reserva): 12%, Stille Nacht aged for years in wine barrels, limited editions
